siteSource: docs/LUNAR_ADDITIONAL_SITES_RESEARCH.md catalog row 4 (Shoemaker Rim A, LM2), NASA Lunar Surface Data Book M2M-30044 Table A2.1-1. PGDA/Data Book reference point; center of an original candidate-region polygon; not an approved landing site.

featureNotes.ridge: Highest source pixel within 250 m of the sampled skyline at grid bearing 220 degrees from the site: a crest grid-southwest of the site, about 6.4 km away and 343 m above it, forming the far skyline of the initial view. Descriptive label from numeric LM2 elevation and illustrative hillshade; not an IAU feature name.
featureNotes.third: Off-grid holdout on terrain grid-east-southeast of the site, about 2.9 km away; no mission significance.
featureNotes.nearDetail: Gentlest 25 m window (about 4.7 degree plane-fit slope) within 45 m of the saved point, about 42 m grid-north of it. The surroundings slope about 6 to 7 degrees, rising grid-southeast. Selected for scale-figure footing, not landing suitability.
featureNotes.crop: 12 x 12 km, shifted 2 km grid-west and 2 km grid-south of the saved point so that the crests seen from the initial view (a rise about 3.2-3.4 km away and the ridge 6.1-6.8 km away) lie inside the crop. A planar 24-bearing raster scan from the viewpoint, plus 4-degree steps across the view, found every skyline point at least 2.6 km inside the crop boundary.

siteLimitations: The saved point lies on the outer slope of the Shoemaker rim region, rising grid-southeast; the 12 x 12 km crop includes neither Shoemaker crater nor its interior.

The crop omits a low rise about 11.6-12 km grid-southwest of the viewpoint, near the LM2 raster edge, which a planar raster scan from the viewpoint places up to about 0.5 degrees above the modeled skyline at grid bearings 232-236 degrees.
The astronaut stands on a gently sloping triangle selected for footing; no claim of walkability, safe footing or landing suitability.
